reviews.title: No reply from the help team and lack of communication
reviews.text: The app is great in general and has a good subscription fee. However I have already emailed the help team about a bug on the app where as the following of the text starts speeding up and does not match the actual verse which is being spoken if that makes sense. At least add a feature to remove the following of the text if it’s not gonna be accurate, still waiting for a reply or a bug fix. I do not pay the subscription fee for there to be a lazy team on the other end that’s what I don’t appreciate. Please either fix the bug or add an option whereas I do not need the audio to follow text because I can follow it myself if it is incapable. Already emailed the @help team and have received no reply not a fix so please do something about.
